test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 437 504 395 482 273 (Right)

(Example: 697 - first digit = 6, second digit = 9, and third digit = 7)

Note: All operations are performed from left to right.

What will be the result if the third digit of the largest number is added to the second digit of the smallest number?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 437 504 395 482 273 (Right)

The largest number is 504.

The third digit of 504 = 4

The smallest number is 273.

The second digit of 273 = 7

Sum = 4 + 7 = 11

Thus, 11 will be the result if the third digit of the largest number is added to the second digit of the smallest number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
